description.en: A collection of creative animated React components built with Motion and Tailwind CSS.
description.zh: 基于 Motion 与 Tailwind CSS 构建的创意 React 动效组件库，主打灵动光标跟随、画廊滚动与质感微交互。

content.en: ObsidianUI is an open-source React component library crafted for developers and designers who want to elevate their interfaces with expressive motion. Built on top of Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion, it features a curated set of interactive effects including Apple-style spotlights, magnetic image trails, physics rope cursors, SVG path marquees, 3D book flips, and fractal glass shaders. Every component comes with cleanly isolated source code, enabling fast copy-paste integration and flexible customization.
content.zh: ObsidianUI 是一套面向创意网页与现代产品的开源 React 动效组件库，基于 Tailwind CSS 与 Framer Motion 深度定制。区别于常规基础组件，它专注于提供极具视觉张力的交互模块，涵盖 Apple 风格聚光灯、磁性图片拖尾、物理绳索与气场光标、SVG 路径跑马灯、3D 翻书以及分形玻璃折射等独特微动效。所有组件均以独立源码分发，开箱即用且高度可拓展。
